Use-after-free after interrupted session shutdown.

The session extension records the filename of the executing script when a session starts. If a fatal error occurs in an application callback while the session variables are destroyed at shutdown, such as stream_close() of a user-defined stream wrapper, the pointer is retained after the request memory is freed, and a later request handled by the same worker can free the stale string. An attacker who can trigger such a failing cleanup may crash the worker or corrupt memory; code execution has not been demonstrated. This requires the filename to be allocated in request memory, for example when the script is not cached by OPcache.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Incorrect RFC 3986 URI serialization for oversized input.

The Uri\Rfc3986\Uri class does not correctly handle the output-size limit and errors of the uriparser library when converting a URI back to a string. For a URI whose string representation reaches approximately 2 GiB, toString(), toRawString() and other serializing operations can return a truncated or invalid string instead of an error. An application that accepts attacker-controlled URI data of that size, has enough memory to process it and trusts the result may make incorrect validation or routing decisions, and the large allocations can exhaust memory. parse_url() and Uri\WhatWg\Url are not affected.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Double free during DOM XML serialization.

The XML serializer of Dom\XMLDocument and Dom\HTMLDocument can share ownership of a generated namespace prefix between the namespace-prefix maps of an element and a descendant, so the prefix is used after being freed and then freed a second time. The document does not need to be malformed. An application that parses attacker-controlled XML or HTML with these classes and serializes it with saveXml() can be crashed, and repeated requests can cause denial of service. Code execution has not been demonstrated.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

An unauthenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability was found in the survey passthrough routing and Data Import processing logic, in which a malicious user could potentially exploit it by manipulating HTTP requests to access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and by supplying a crafted file-path/stream parameter during import handling. If successfully exploited, this could allow the attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code on the REDCap server. The attacker does not have to be authenticated in order to exploit this, but exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash. This vulnerability exists in REDCap 13.3.0 and higher.

django-docutils provides reStructuredText support for Django. Prior to 0.30.0, public rendering paths including publish_doctree, publish_html_from_source, publish_html_from_doctree, publish_parts_from_doctree, the {% rst %} template tag, the rst template filter, DocutilsTemplates, and DocutilsView pass lower-trust reStructuredText to Docutils without disabling file_insertion_enabled, raw_enabled, ambient docutils.conf processing, or unsafe URI schemes and without consistently sanitizing doctrees. An attacker who can influence rendered reStructuredText can use include or csv-table directives to read local files or cause server-side URL requests, or use raw HTML and unsafe URI output to inject stored script-capable content. Applications that render only trusted static reStructuredText are not affected unless attackers can influence it. This issue is fixed in version 0.30.0.

The Strava datasource plugin's resource handler POST /strava-api forwards a client-supplied endpoint string, and its query parameters, to the Strava API (https://www.strava.com/api/v3/<endpoint>) without validation.

When the datasource is not in OAuth pass-through mode, the request is made with the access token stored on the datasource, not the caller's identity. Grafana authorises plugin resource calls only on the datasources:query permission, which Viewers have by default. Any such caller could therefore request any Strava API path the connected account's OAuth grant allows, for example athlete/clubs or routes/{id}, and read the response.

The plugin's frontend (stravaApi.ts) only needs a fixed set of paths: athlete, athlete/activities, activities/{id}, activities/{id}/streams and segments/{id}.

Requests to Strava are GET only, so the issue is read-only.

Affected: plugin versions 1.2.0 through 1.7.2. The fix restricts endpoint to those five patterns and is pending release. The check runs before the access token is resolved, so a rejected request never causes a token refresh or any call to Strava. Paths with .. segments are rejected as well.

When Private data source connect (PDC) or a secure SOCKS proxy is used, the MQTT data source plugin does not apply TLS to broker connections for the tls, ssl, tcps, mqtts and mqtt+ssl schemes. The configured TLS settings are ignored, and the broker username and password are sent unencrypted on the hop between the proxy and the broker. The server certificate is not verified, and a configured client certificate is not sent.

A vulnerability has been found in DataLinkDC dinky up to 1.2.5. Affected by this issue is the function CatalogueController.upload of the file dinky-admin/src/main/java/org/dinky/controller/CatalogueController.java of the component Catalogue Upload API. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker, with knowledge of a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content, to conduct an unauthorized access attack due to improper authentication mechanisms. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability is limited to the affected functionality and does not provide unrestricted access to arbitrary files elsewhere on the system. This is MTLVULN-1863.

Aperi'Solve is an open-source steganalysis web platform. Prior to 3.4.2, an unauthenticated user can submit a PNG to POST /upload, which reaches aperisolve/utils/png.py through analyze_image, PCRTAnalyzer, PNG.repair(), and check_idat(). A malformed IDAT chunk can make attacker-controlled length and newline data drive an unbounded combinations search in PNG._fix_dos2unix(), causing repeated CRC checks that occupy a worker and delay or block image analysis for other users. Per-IP upload limits and eventual job termination bound the denial of service, and the issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 3.4.2.

Missing authorization in PersistentCache in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to bypass site isolation via a crafted PDF file. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, the authenticated URL-upload endpoint and authenticated embed endpoint fetch user-supplied URLs server-side without protection against internal targets, allowing an attacker with the applicable backend permission to cause the Bolt server to request those targets. This issue is fixed in version 6.1.4.

Incorrect authorization in Navigation in Google Chrome on on iOS prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to bypass site isolation into a privileged page via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to leverage pre-staged malicious content to conduct an XML injection attack due to insufficient parameter validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1862.

Redmine 6.1.0 before 6.1.6 and 7.0.0 before 7.0.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets OAuth clients exceed token scope during project creation. A client with only project-creation scope can set is_public, enabled_module_names and inherit_members, making projects public and granting parent-project members subproject access.

Improper input validation in DOMStorage in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to bypass site isolation via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

Dell PowerStore contains a Missing Authentication vulnerability that a network-adjacent attacker could exploit to bypass authentication and authorization, leading to information disclosure and denial of service.

WebToffee Product Feed before 2.4.4 for WordPress contains a use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the URL-cron signature check by computing a valid hash using the publicly known constant salt embedded in the plugin source. cves.d: The Fancy Lightbox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation without administrator interaction requires that the attacker first have one comment approved so that a subsequent payload comment is auto-published; the injected script only executes when a user clicks the malicious image link inside the comment. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

The AIKTP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass via Predictable Token in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.7. The vulnerability exists because the plugin's sync token (`aiktpz_token`) is generated using PHP's non-cryptographic `uniqid()` function — producing a wall-clock-derived value with approximately one million microsecond candidates per uncertain generation second — while the unauthenticated, unthrottled REST endpoint `/wp-json/aiktp/checkToken` (registered with `permission_callback => __return_true`) acts as a public brute-force oracle for the token; simultaneously, the capability checks in `check_valid_token` and its wrappers (`verify_aiktp_token_with_edit_capability`, `verify_aiktp_token_with_upload_capability`) inspect only a server-side stored Administrator account (option `aiktp_author`) rather than the actual REST caller, meaning possession of the token alone grants Administrator-equivalent authority to any external request. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to recover the sync token and then invoke `POST /wp-json/aiktp/createpost` to publish arbitrary posts attributed to a site Administrator, `POST /wp-json/aiktp/doUpdatePostWithImageURL` to overwrite the body content of any existing post, and `POST /wp-json/aiktp/doUploadImageToWP` to import remote media and attach it as the featured image of any post. Additionally, when the `aiktpz_token` option has never been initialized, the `checkToken` oracle returns success for an empty token submission due to a loose comparison in `check_valid_token`, providing a zero-effort bypass that requires no brute-forcing whatsoever.

Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere vulnerability in Mamunur Rashid ShopBuilder – Elementor WooCommerce Builder Addons shopbuilder allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects ShopBuilder – Elementor WooCommerce Builder Addons: from n/a through 3.4.3.

A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester E-Commerce Shopping Cart Web Application 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file action.php. The manipulation of the argument keyword results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

Vulnerability in the Oracle Access Manager product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Authentication Engine).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and  14.1.2.1.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Access Manager.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle Access Manager, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Access Manager accessible data as well as  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Access Manager accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of Oracle Access Manager. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 10.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L).

Missing authorization in Autofill in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to bypass site isolation via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

A vulnerability has been found in GearUP Hyperev up to 20261020. This affects an unknown function. Such manipulation leads to on-chip debug and test interface with improper access control. The attack can be executed directly on the physical device. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 and 2.0.3, main/lp/scormItem.class.php and public/main/lp/scormItem.class.php store an attacker-controlled title element from imsmanifest.xml without cross-site scripting sanitization when a teacher imports a SCORM package. The title reaches c_lp_item.title and is rendered by src/CoreBundle/Resources/views/LearnPath/scorm_list.html.twig through item.title with raw output while Twig auto-escaping is disabled; the default configuration does not apply the optional AI-disclosure sanitization path. Enrolled students or administrators who view the learning-path table of contents can execute the stored content in their browser sessions. This issue is fixed in versions 1.11.40 and 2.0.3.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. From 2.0.0 until 2.0.3, the BigBlueButton plugin is vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) injection when an authenticated administrator configures a malicious BigBlueButton server URL. Processing attacker-controlled XML from that server can read arbitrary local files and perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). Sensitive configuration, credentials, source code, and internal network resources may be exposed. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 2.0.3, POST /api/social_posts accepts attacker-controlled content that SocialPost::setContent stores without cross-site scripting sanitization, and assets/vue/components/social/SocialWallPost.vue renders post.content through v-html without sanitization. Any authenticated user can create a social-wall post that executes active content when another authenticated user views the wall. The script can run in an administrator's browser session and expose session data or perform actions with the victim's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.

ALTCHA PHP is a lightweight PHP library for creating and verifying ALTCHA challenges. From 2.0.0 until 2.0.3, the verifySolution method skips HMAC signature verification when a challenge payload omits the signature field, even when hmacSignatureSecret is configured. An attacker can remove the signature, supply attacker-selected low-difficulty challenge parameters, solve the resulting proof of work, and submit a payload that verifies successfully, bypassing the CAPTCHA control. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.

Missing authorization in FileSystem in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process and leveraged social engineering to bypass site isolation via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-uhttpd before commit d38658bedbdd811b798da16b49301478c6cf21af grants '/*' file read in its rpcd read ACL, which rpcd's fnmatch matching applies to every path. Users delegated only luci-app-uhttpd read access can read any file as root, including /etc/shadow, /etc/config/* credentials, /etc/uhttpd.key, and /etc/dropbear keys.

pnpm exe before 10.34.8 embeds an outdated Node.js runtime that still trusts compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates during registry TLS connections. Network attackers holding a recovered intermediate key can intercept standalone pnpm registry fetches and serve forged package metadata or tarballs.

Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via unbounded BER recursion in PKCS#7 parsing. Attackers can send deeply nested indefinite-length structures to Apple MDM check-in, enrollment, SCEP, or OTA endpoints to crash the entire Fleet instance.

Obot from 0.8.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Power User accounts to reach internal hosts by advertising a malicious OAuth token endpoint in remote MCP server metadata. Attackers can direct token exchange or refresh requests, including redirected GET requests, to cloud metadata services or private-network hosts and read error response bodies.

Obot from 0.14.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Power Users to bypass outbound protections by supplying unspecified addresses, IPv6 transition addresses, or registry icon URLs. Attackers can add remote MCP servers pointing to 0.0.0.0, ::, or NAT64/6to4/Teredo addresses embedding blocked IPv4 addresses to probe internal services for reachability.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted TLS clients to read other projects' bucket S3 keys and profile configuration through recursive and all-projects responses. Attackers can query bucket listings with recursion=2 or profiles with all-projects=true to obtain S3 secret keys and sensitive environment, cloud-init and user values across projects.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with project event-view access to read migration websocket secrets broadcast in operation metadata. Attackers can connect to in-flight migration control and fs websockets before the legitimate peer, hijacking the transfer to obtain instance configuration and filesystem data.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories by supplying unvalidated dependent volume and snapshot names in the migration offer header. Attackers controlling a migration source can create root-owned volumes with attacker content at arbitrary host paths, compromising hosts using dir storage pools, bypassing restricted.storage-pools.access, or crashing the daemon.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted clients to create and access default project resources by exploiting entitlement checks against the requested project. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq directives to execute code as root on the host, or manipulate inherited resources via the ?project= parameter.

SemanticMediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.4.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in CsvFileExportPrinter and DsvResultPrinter via unescaped valuesep and separator parameters. Attackers can craft Special:Ask links using request_type=special_page so export output renders as text/html, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers under the wiki origin.

Incorrect authorization in SiteSettings in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to bypass system access restrictions via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Low)

The rsyslog's`imuxsock` special parser can end up writing into the received message raw buffer when trying to replace the message timestamp with the system's timestamp. A local attacker with the ability to write to the `imuxsock` socket can leverage that by crafting a malformed PRI value with a short timestamp to lead the rsyslog to perform the out-of-bounds write.

X-Road is open-source data exchange layer software. Prior to 7.8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.4, HashChainVerifier in the common-message module resolves attacker-controlled batch-signature hash chains before verifying the message signature and signing certificate, without cycle detection, recursion-depth or total-step limits, or per-step memoization. A registered ecosystem member can send a small crafted hashchain MIME part with repeated or cyclic StepRef values so that verifyHashChain() performs exponential work or unbounded recursion before authentication. Repeated requests can exhaust Security Server proxy threads and deny data-exchange service, and a self-reference can raise an uncaught error. This issue is fixed in versions 7.8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.4.

LLMKube is a Kubernetes operator for self-hosted large language model inference across heterogeneous hardware. Prior to 0.9.0, the ModelReconciler accepts arbitrary absolute paths and file:// URIs in Model.spec.source without restricting them to approved roots. A namespace user who can create or update Model and InferenceService resources can cause copyLocalModel to open an attacker-selected file in the controller pod or cause a HostPathVolumeSource to mount an attacker-selected node file when modelCache.enabled is enabled, which is the default. The selected file is copied into model storage and can expose controller service-account credentials or other node secrets outside the attacker's namespace. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

AnsibleForms is a self-hosted web application that turns automation into self-service forms. Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms allows a user with repository management privileges to inject shell syntax through repository uri, branch, name, or host values processed by server/src/models/repo.model.js. The Repo.clone and Repo.addKnownHosts paths interpolate these values into git and ssh-keyscan command strings, and server/src/lib/cmd.js executes the strings through Cmd.executeSilentCommand with shell interpretation enabled. Creating or updating a repository can therefore execute arbitrary commands as the AnsibleForms application process. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.1.

OliveTin gives safe and simple access to predefined shell commands from a web interface. From 3000.0.0 until 3000.18.1, OliveTin passes attacker-influenceable output and ot_username values into shellAfterCompleted processing in service/internal/executor/executor.go without applying checkShellArgumentSafety, the shell-safety validation used for primary action execution. The same post-execution template path also expands exitCode without that validation, but the advisory does not establish attacker control of the exit-code value. When an action configures shellAfterCompleted with output or ot_username, shell metacharacters from command output, external data processed by an action, or a trusted-header username can become syntax in the command executed by the stepExecAfter path. This can execute arbitrary commands as the OliveTin process user, including when the primary action uses the safer exec-array mode. This issue is fixed in version 3000.18.1.

SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors HTTP endpoint, which lacks the @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL) decorator applied to its sibling admin endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network-reachable attackers to invoke it without an API key. Attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model, and when combined with a separately documented deserialization bypass, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution as root.

MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import, Docker support, and collection statistics. Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/database/import handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/database.py accepts a ZIP archive and moves an included database file to DATABASE_PATH while also replacing IMAGE_PATH content. An attacker can supply a database containing an attacker-controlled users table and administrative account, then authenticate as that account; invalid replacement data can also destroy application data or availability. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.2.

Wavelog is web-based amateur radio logging software. Prior to 2.5, the filename parameter accepted by POST /qsl/addQsoToQsl in application/controllers/Qsl.php addQsoToQsl() is stored without rejecting directory separators or relative path components, and POST /qsl/delete reaches application/models/Qsl_model.php deleteQsl(), which passes the planted qsl_images filename to unlink(). A standard authenticated user can associate the malicious filename with the user's own QSO, satisfy the ownership check, escape the per-user QSL image directory, and delete files writable by the PHP worker. Deleting configuration or operational files can cause denial of service, while deleting installer gate files can reopen the unauthenticated installer and enable application identity takeover through attacker-controlled database configuration. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.

PGPainless is a simple-to-use OpenPGP API based on Bouncy Castle. Prior to 1.7.8 and from 2.0.0 until 2.0.4, pgpainless-sop/src/main/kotlin/org/pgpainless/sop/InlineDetachImpl.kt InlineDetachImpl and pgpainless-core/src/main/kotlin/org/pgpainless/decryption_verification/MessageInspector.kt MessageInspector manually descend PGPCompressedData packets without incrementing or enforcing MAX_LAYER_DEPTH. A remote unauthenticated attacker can supply an untrusted OpenPGP message containing deeply nested compressed packet structures to a downstream application using inline-detach or message inspection, bypass the intended 16-layer limit, and force continued decompression and packet processing. The resulting resource consumption can block processing threads, exhaust heap memory, and crash the consuming application. This issue is fixed in versions 1.7.8 and 2.0.4.

A vulnerability was identified in SECUDOCX DMP up to 9.0.0 Build 1027. This affects an unknown function of the file /DMP/public/login/forward_login.jsp of the component Login. The manipulation of the argument LoginErrorMsg leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security vulnerability has been detected in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file mainfunction.cgi of the component Apmcfg Upload. The manipulation leads to null pointer dereference. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

Open OnDemand is an open-source high-performance computing portal. Prior to 4.1.6 and 4.2.3, apps/dashboard/config/initializers/session_store.rb stores dashboard sessions by default in a predictable /var/tmp/<username> directory, or in another location configured by an administrator, but omits PUN user directory ownership and mode 0700 validation. A local attacker can pre-create another user's directory, read the victim's session identifier and CSRF token after login, or stage a predetermined session identifier. ActiveSupport file-store deserialization of attacker-controlled cache data may also occur in the victim's context, enabling file modification or code execution with the victim's privileges. This issue is fixed in versions 4.1.6 and 4.2.3.

Gortex is a high-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents and integrated development environments. Prior to 0.55.0, resolveFilePath in internal/mcp/tools_fileops.go accepts absolute paths without checking indexed repository roots, while write_file, edit_file, and move_inline in internal/mcp/tools_move_inline.go omit guardSymlinkWithinRepo before reaching AtomicWriteFile and related write sinks. A caller that can influence MCP tool arguments can therefore create or overwrite files anywhere the daemon user can access, including startup or hook files that execute code on a later trigger. The flaw violates Gortex's repository-confinement invariant and can lead to arbitrary host code execution. This issue is fixed in version 0.55.0.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI header parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A header parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI query parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A query parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

A vulnerability was found in October CMS up to 4.4.6. This affects the function validateExternalImageHost of the file modules/system/classes/resizeimages/ValidatesExternalImages.php of the component Image Resizer. Performing a manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be initiated remotely. The complexity of an attack is rather high. The exploitability is reported as difficult. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 4.4.7 mitigates this issue. The patch is named f6372867006c03141944e7b57396a726eb02acf0. You should upgrade the affected component.

A flaw has been found in MemTensor memmy-agent up to 1.1.1. This impacts an unknown function of the file /api/v1/memory/logs of the component Memory HTTP Service. This manipulation causes information disclosure. The attack is restricted to local execution. The exploit has been published and may be used. Patch name: 421ce6cb33861255d34c3887d39aced009b3ce9b. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the database password validation used by the MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and Redis change-password procedures permits backticks, and the procedures interpolate attacker-controlled passwords into Bash command strings. An authenticated user who can update a database password can trigger command substitution before the database command runs, resulting in arbitrary operating-system command execution with the Dokploy process privileges, which are typically root. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the backup prefix field is only checked for a nonempty value, and normalizeS3Path preserves shell metacharacters before the prefix is interpolated into rclone upload and retention-cleanup command strings. An authenticated organization member with backup permission for a service can execute arbitrary commands as root on the Dokploy host or configured remote server when a PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, libSQL, Compose, or web-server backup runs manually, on schedule, or performs retention cleanup. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.0, failed Railpack builds and database backups propagate an execution error containing the full command, exposing application environment variables, database passwords, and S3 access keys embedded in those commands. When the corresponding App Build Error or Database Backup notification setting is enabled, the disclosure can send secrets to email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, or webhooks; the same secrets are written separately to persistent Dokploy container logs, which may be accessible to more principals than the affected service. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.0.

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, verify_bundle in mareforma/export_bundle.py validates the outer DSSE envelope and exporter-signed subject digests, but JSONLDExporter._claim_node in mareforma/exporters/jsonld.py supplies no signatureBundle for individual claims. Because the exporter signs both the predicate nodes and their digest list, the check proves only internal bundle consistency and allows claims with missing, invalid, or forged asserter signatures to be accepted as authentic. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying crafted XMT files. Attackers can assign a second node to an SFNode command field so xmt_node_end() frees a forward-referenced child still cached in peeked_nodes, triggering a crash during DEF lookup in xmt_find_node().

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT parser that leaves parser->command_buffer pointing into a freed InputSensor node. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file triggering a parse error so xmt_node_start() writes NULL into freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c that leaves freed forward-referenced nodes cached in parser->peeked_nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a node targeted by an SFCommandBuffer command, triggering a later DEF lookup on the freed node and crashing MP4Box.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves ROUTE commands of a discarded node queued after being freed by gf_sg_command_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file imported with MP4Box so xmt_resolve_routes() writes to freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing the process.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_isom_get_meta() in src/isomedia/meta.c that reads file->moov->trackList without checking the moov box exists. Attackers can supply a crafted ISOBMFF file with malformed AV1 configuration data that leaves moov unset, crashing MP4Box -infon and causing denial of service.

Geany through 2.1.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to run shell commands by embedding metacharacters in filenames substituted into build and execute commands. Attackers can craft a file named with backticks or $(...) that executes via /bin/sh when a user runs Compile, Build or Execute, gaining code execution as the user.

A vulnerability was found in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This affects the function SqlUtils.batchExecute of the file /api/database/upload of the component Database Maintenance Module. The manipulation results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

ScreenTinker before 3.2.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the GET /api/kiosk/:id/render endpoint that allows users with kiosk page edit rights to store javascript: URLs in page buttons. Attackers can trigger script execution in the dashboard origin when an administrator activates the button, hijacking the victim's session and taking full control of the instance.

Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a PHP code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject code via the updatedFields parameter into config.inc.php. Attackers can supply a crafted HELPDESK_SUPPORT_EMAIL_ID value that passes email validation but closes the PHP string literal to execute arbitrary operating system commands.

A vulnerability was determined in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This vulnerability affects the function FileUtil.upload of the file /api/localStorage of the component File Upload Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A security vulnerability has been detected in SEO Panel 6.0.0. This affects the function mime_content_type of the file controllers/website.ctrl.php of the component Website Import. Such manipulation of the argument website_csv_file leads to unrestricted upload. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 7.0.0 mitigates this issue. The name of the patch is 2a2d4aeb718177327b0cd8ce17e2f40328772127. You should upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /web/admin/add_food.php. Such manipulation leads to unrestricted upload. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

A vulnerability was found in GearUP Hyperev up to 20261020. This impacts the function get_wlan_sitesurvey of the file ld/utils.lua of the component WLAN Site Survey. Performing a manipulation of the argument line results in os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

The WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro plugins for WordPress are vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 and 6.17.0, respectively, via deserialization of untrusted input during database restore and staging reset. This is due to the database importer treating attacker-controlled text beginning with {WPSTG_BINARY} as trusted internal binary data and decoding its hexadecimal suffix into serialized bytes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to plant a malicious serialized object in their own profile. When an Administrator later performs an ordinary database-including restore or staging reset containing that value, and the restored profile metadata is loaded, either during the restore or in a later request, a built-in POP chain can be used to execute arbitrary code on the server. Additional built-in gadget chains allow arbitrary local file read in both WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro and arbitrary file deletion in WP STAGING Pro. The attacker does not require Administrator credentials or a copy of a backup, but exploitation does require the later privileged restore or reset.
vp: wp staging pro wordpress backup plugin
wp staging – backups & restore, migration & clone plugin – cloud backups, scheduled backups

cves.d: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Deepen Bajracharya Video Conferencing with Zoom video-conferencing-with-zoom-api allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Video Conferencing with Zoom: from n/a through 4.6.12.

The Slimbox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment (anchor title within comment HTML)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. WordPress core comment KSES permits unauthenticated commenters to post anchor elements with href and title attributes, so an entity-encoded payload stored in the title attribute survives sanitization verbatim; the browser then decodes the entities when populating the DOM .title property, and the Slimbox library's jQuery .html() caption sink renders it as executable HTML.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a cryptographically weak PRNG vulnerability that could allow a network attacker to decrypt or tamper with NAS SSH/SFTP sessions.

Termix 1.7.0 before 26.11.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write files outside the export directory via crafted usernames. Attackers can self-register with a username containing ../ segments and request POST /database/export to plant attacker-controlled SQLite files in writable directories, enabling disk exhaustion.

yt through 4.4.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute Python code by supplying a crafted con_args attribute in a ytdata HDF5 file. SavedDataset._parse_parameter_file() passes con_args to eval() unrestricted, so loading a malicious .h5 file with yt.load() runs attacker code as the user.

modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in gv_send.php because the action=process step never validates a CSRF token via check_secure_form(). Attackers can host an auto-submitting form that makes a logged-in customer send their gift voucher balance to an attacker-controlled email address for redemption.

A Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information (CWE-319) vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. A man-in-the-middle attacker may be able to tamper with data transmitted between the application and the server, resulting in the display of modified content to users.

HotGo 2.18.6 through 2.19.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to read other administrators' private letters because the messageIds helper omits the receiver filter. Low-privilege users can call GET /admin/notice/pullMessages, which is exempt from role permission checks via exceptAuth, to retrieve titles, contents and senders of private letters.

Tiptap @tiptap/core 2.0.0-alpha.0 before 3.30.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM attributes via a __proto__ key passed to mergeAttributes(). Attackers can supply untrusted JSON attribute data whose __proto__ replaces the merged object's prototype, causing DOMSerializer.renderSpec to render injected event handlers that execute JavaScript.

littlefs 2.8.0 through 2.11.3 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability in lfs_mount_() that allows attackers to crash processes mounting crafted filesystem images when block_count is 0. Attackers can supply an image lacking a superblock entry or recording block_count 0, causing lfs->seed % lfs->block_count to trigger SIGFPE and denial of service.

Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows administrators with product editing permission to inject script via the products_name field. The unescaped name is rendered in the h1 heading of product detail and reviews pages, executing script in the browsers of shoppers and logged-in customers.

HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, fai_retrieve does not verify that the line width recorded in a FASTA .fai index is greater than or equal to the number of bases per line. When the line width is exactly one less than the base count, retrieval allocates an undersized heap buffer and writes one byte beyond its end; larger discrepancies instead cause an allocation failure that is handled. This issue can corrupt heap memory and crash the process. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in tfsxml_leave() caused by an off-by-one error when handling generic <! markup in truncated XML. Attackers can supply a crafted media file with malformed ADM XML parsed by File_Adm.cpp to crash MediaInfo or applications using MediaInfoLib.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because gf_node_free() frees nodes without detaching routes that still reference them via FromNode. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTO graphs so gf_sg_route_del() accesses freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting the heap.

In specific versions of Octopus Tentacle, Tentacle fails to unset registration credentials as environment variables, resulting in deployment scripts potentially having the ability to read those credentials.

HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the experimental CRAM v4 XPACK and XRLE decoders cache expanded block pointers at indexes beyond the 512-element slice->block_by_id array. An array index partially controlled by data in the input file first causes an out-of-bounds read to determine whether a block is cached; a null value then causes allocation of a block and an out-of-bounds pointer write to the same element. The invalid read may crash the process, while the write may corrupt heap state and could permit arbitrary code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

The certificate authentication info handling in gnutls from 2.5.9 up to 3.8.13 does not reset the certificate count and list pointer when re-allocation of raw_certificate_list fails, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service for a peer under heap pressure.

The RSA-PSK ClientKeyExchange handler in gnutls before 3.8.14 does not return after detecting a memory allocation failure when copying the PSK username, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service for a peer under heap pressure.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() that allows attackers to write a zero byte outside the heap line buffer via crafted XML attribute values. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a ROUTE or command referencing an undefined node, imported with MP4Box, to crash the process and corrupt memory.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via unchecked field lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose atIndexField names a non-existent node field, causing a NULL read during import and denial of service.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2 two-factor authentication bypass was possible via access token management
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4 an SSRF via connection tests was possible for users without project edit permissions

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in ReplaceDEFNode that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by triggering access to a partly freed child list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file whose InputSensor command buffer cascades prototype sub-graph deletion during gf_sg_vrml_parent_destroy, causing denial of service.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2 missing authorization allowed reading Qodana reports of other projects

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by attaching nodes from unrelated proto sub-graphs to field-replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene buffering such a command in a Conditional node, causing gf_node_try_destroy() to access the freed node, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 stored XSS on build and queue pages was possible

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, _maybe_update_replicated_unlocked in mareforma/db/core.py does not check t_invalid in its new-claim gate, peer-selection query, or final update, so a claim marked invalid by a signed contradiction verdict can still be promoted to REPLICATED through convergence. The invalidated claim can also act as the corroborating peer that promotes an honest claim, bypassing the trust ladder's terminal refutation state. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 arbitrary file deletion on the server was possible via the Kotlin DSL sandbox
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 an LDAP injection allowed bypassing login restrictions
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 stored XSS on the Issue Log tab was possible
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 stored XSS on the P4 Code Review build tab was possible

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.7, the _maybe_update_replicated_unlocked convergence path in mareforma/db/core.py uses generated_by labels without requiring a valid signature_bundle from a distinct enrolled signer, so an unsigned claim written to a shared graph can converge with a signed peer and be promoted to REPLICATED. The forged trust state is returned by queries requiring REPLICATED support, allowing false multi-party endorsement signals to reach downstream consumers. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.7.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 unauthenticated DoS via the agent protocol was possible
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 project viewers could redirect GitHub App connection credentials of parent projects

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). In 0.31.0 and earlier, the hosted installer and manual installation instructions set /etc/dokploy to mode 0777, allowing a local non-root user on a shared host to replace root-owned schedule or Traefik configuration directories. Dokploy subsequently consumes those paths as trusted configuration and can execute substituted scheduled-task scripts as root, resulting in local privilege escalation.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 stored XSS in the AWS Credentials build feature was possible
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 missing authorization allowed project viewers to remove VCS roots

DOMShell is a Chrome automation project whose MCP server exposes Unix-style tools for AI agents. Prior to 2.0.8, the DOMShell MCP server classifies the domshell_eval tool and eval command as read-tier operations that can run without --allow-write, even though eval shares the Runtime.evaluate dispatch path with the write-tier js command and has no side-effect gate. An MCP caller with tool-session access can therefore use domshell_eval to mutate DOM, window, or global state while the host approval interface, server authorization flags, denial messages, and audit records represent the operation as read-only. The bypass does not expose a capability beyond domshell_js for callers already authorized to write, but it violates the configured permission boundary for callers lacking that authorization. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.8.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 missing authorization allowed any authenticated user to start and stop cloud agent instances
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 access keys of parent project AWS connections could be disclosed

A vulnerability has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function doWebBackup of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component Backup Handler. Such manipulation of the argument path/value leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to resolve this issue. The affected component should be upgraded. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 improper authorization allowed publishing packages to NuGet feeds of other projects

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, Jane's Reference.php::doResolve passes an attacker-controlled OpenAPI $ref target to file_get_contents without restricting its scheme or resolved local path. When a victim generates code from an attacker-influenced document, an HTTP or HTTPS reference can cause requests to attacker-chosen or internal services, while an absolute or parent-relative path can read local JSON or YAML files and inline the retrieved content into generated output. Exploitation occurs during generation or CI processing and can disclose local files and internal-service responses. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 secure parameter values were disclosed to project viewers in pipelines
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 stored XSS in the NPM Registry build feature was possible

A double free in the X.509 name constraints enforcement of GnuTLS 3.8.13 on all platforms allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service (application crash) via a certificate chain containing a NameConstraints extension processed while the application is under memory pressure. When an already populated name constraints object is reinitialized, previously freed list pointers are not cleared, so a memory allocation failure precisely at reinitialization leaves a dangling pointer that is freed again during a later cleanup.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 arbitrary file write on the server was possible via Kotlin DSL settings
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 improper authorization allowed access to credentials of other projects via build configuration settings
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 an SSRF in AWS connection settings could expose server credentials
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 an SSRF via pipeline repository branch listing was possible

A maliciously crafted SBSAR file, when imported or loaded through the Substance in 3ds Max plugin in Autodesk 3ds Max, can trigger a Stack Overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor may leverage this vulnerability to cause an application crash.

A maliciously crafted SBSAR file, when imported or loaded through the Substance in 3ds Max plugin in Autodesk 3ds Max, can trigger an Out-of-Bounds Write vulnerability. A malicious actor may leverage this vulnerability to cause an application crash, data corruption, or potentially execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2 privilege escalation was possible via the authorization flow

A maliciously crafted SBSAR file, when imported or loaded through the Substance in 3ds Max plugin in Autodesk 3ds Max, can trigger an Out-of-Bounds Read (table-index lookup) vulnerability. A malicious actor may leverage this vulnerability to cause an application crash or potentially read sensitive data from the current process.

A maliciously crafted SBSAR file, when imported or loaded through the Substance in 3ds Max plugin in Autodesk 3ds Max, can trigger an Out-of-Bounds Read (unvalidated element begin-pointer) vulnerability. A malicious actor may leverage this vulnerability to cause an application crash or potentially read sensitive data from the current process.

The static codes used for information transmission
throughout the 433.92 MHz system of the Guardian 2 system allow an attacker in
proximity to monitor the movements of users inside the premises where the
sensors are set up. This is further aided by the fact that codes transmitted
reveal sensor type, although sensor location cannot be inferred from this
traffic alone.

djangocms-moderation provides an approval workflow mechanism for organizations that require content approval before publication. Prior to 2.4.0, CollectionCommentAdmin and RequestCommentAdmin in the Django admin use changelist_view and changeform_view to scope comment access through caller-controlled object identifiers and model-level view_collectioncomment or view_requestcomment permissions without invoking ModerationRequest.user_can_view_comments() or an equivalent collection participant check. An authenticated staff user with either view permission can enumerate collection or moderation-request identifiers and read full comment messages for workflows they do not participate in. The exposure affects confidentiality of internal editorial discussions; comment creation, modification, and deletion remain protected, and integrity and availability are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 2.4.0.

The Guardian 2 alarm unit lacks a mechanism to
authenticate control commands sent over 433.92 MHz, which allows an attacker to
replay the static commands to impersonate activity.  The attacker can also disarm or arm the
system at will if a Nexsmart keypad (product link) is in use, thus compromising
the functionality of the alarm system completely.

Vulnerability involving the exposure of sensitive information in the URLs of the UOC Virtual Campus’s document upload feature. After completing a document upload, the application includes identifiers related to the active session—such as `apjsessionid`—and other internal parameters associated with requests and users in the HTTP GET request parameters. This data may be stored in the browser history and in server or proxy logs, or transmitted via the HTTP Referer header, depending on the configuration and browsing flow. Its inclusion in the URL could allow for the unauthorized disclosure of information to third parties with access to those logs or recipients.

django-filer is a file and image management application for Django. Prior to 3.5.0, the delete_files_or_folders action in filer/admin/folderadmin.py checks global Django model-level deletion permission but omits check_folder_edit_permissions and check_files_edit_permissions when FILER_ENABLE_PERMISSIONS is enabled. An authenticated staff user who has a global delete_file, delete_folder, or delete_image permission but is limited to read-only access by FolderPermission can therefore delete files, folders, and descendants from the restricted folder. Deployments using the default disabled per-folder permission system are not affected, and the issue does not create a read-confidentiality impact. This issue is fixed in version 3.5.0.

A cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in Win Bird JYUGYO SHIEN browser extensions for Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge, which allows an attacker to execute arbitrary script in the user's web browser.

In Eclipse iceoryx-rs, versions 0.0.11 to 0.0.13 and 0.1.0 as well as on the latest main branch.



`SampleReceiver::<T>::take()` and `Sample::<T>::deref()` are safe functions that hand the caller a `&T` pointing at a chunk written by another iceoryx process, but the subscriber path neither requires `T: ShmSend` nor verifies that the received chunk is at least `size_of::<T>()` bytes / `align_of::<T>()`-aligned. A peer process that publishes an undersized chunk, or any chunk at all when the subscriber chose a pointer-bearing `T`, drives a `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` subscriber into out-of-bounds reads of adjacent shared-memory chunks or dereference of a publisher-controlled pointer.



Resolution:



It will not be fixed since this is a known limitation in iceoryx as it is the users responsibility to specify the same data type on sender and receiver side.



[iceoryx2](https://github.com/eclipse-iceoryx/iceoryx2) is the successor of iceoryx-rs where the API is designed to prevent this by default.



It is strongly recommended to migrate to iceoryx2 which is actively maintained and receives security support.



The iceoryx-rs package has officially reached End-of-life and will not receive any features, bugfixes or security fixes.

OpenID4VP is an open-source credential parsing library for SD-JWT VC and mDOC/mDL formats. Prior to 0.8.1, src/trust/ChainBuilder.ts ChainBuilder.tryBuild() terminates chain construction when an attacker-controlled certificate Subject Distinguished Name equals a trusted anchor subject, without verifying cryptographic closure to the anchor public key. A remote unauthenticated attacker can supply a self-signed leaf or intermediate that reuses the trusted Subject Distinguished Name and have credentials signed by the attacker key accepted as issued by the trusted authority. The public src/trust/TrustEvaluator.ts TrustEvaluator.evaluate() path compounds the error by matching a terminus through serialNumber and falling back to anchors[0], which can attribute the forged chain to genuine trusted-authority metadata. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.1.

In Eclipse Yasson versions 3.0 to 3.0.5, a race condition (CWE-362) exists in the handling of @JsonbNumberFormat. Yasson creates one java.text.NumberFormat instance per annotated property and shares it across all threads that use the same Jsonb instance. NumberFormat is not thread-safe, and the deserializer called parse() on it without synchronization. When multiple threads deserialize concurrently, a thread can receive a numeric value that belongs to another thread's input, receive an incorrect value, or fail with an exception. A remote attacker who can send concurrent requests to an application that deserializes untrusted JSON this way may cause incorrect data to be processed or cause another user's value to be returned. Exploitation requires that the application use @JsonbNumberFormat with a shared Jsonb instance and that the attacker win a timing race. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.6 by synchronizing access to the shared NumberFormat instances.

Wavelog is web-based amateur radio logging software. Prior to 3.2.4, the application/controllers/Lotw.php import() workflow passes the lotw_download_url configuration value to curl without scheme validation, accepts file:// content, and writes the response to a predictable path under ./uploads/ that can be retrieved through an unauthenticated HTTP request. A standard user can trigger the LotW import, although changing lotw_download_url normally requires installer administrator access, and related vulnerabilities can remove that prerequisite. The same missing status-validation pattern affects the LotW lotw_users fetch helper and per-user download helper. This exposes files readable by the www-data user, including environment data, mounted secrets, and application configuration. This issue is fixed in version 3.2.4.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Dataprom Bilişim Teknolojileri LTD. ŞTİ. DataPer Access Control and Security Systems allows Privilege Escalation.

This issue affects DataPer Access Control and Security Systems: before v14.15(2026/11).
