Deserialization of untrusted data in double-submit cookie vs. form field validation in Idunno.AntiCsrf versions through 0.9.1 Beta on ASP.NET allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code via object injection
JIT miscompilation in the JavaScript Engine: JIT component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 160, Firefox ESR 153.7, Thunderbird 160, and Thunderbird 153.7.

Samsung mTower lacks access control for TA sessions, allowing a Normal World application to open TA sessions and invoke their commands, or use a close existing sessions if thier identifiers are known, The impact depends on the affected TA.

The cleanup of tempfile.TemporaryDirectory is vulnerable to a race condition. An attacker who can modify the tree during cleanup can replace a directory with a symbolic link, causing files outside of the temporary directory to be deleted or have their permissions and file flags reset, with the privileges of the process performing the cleanup. Note that platforms where shutil.rmtree.avoids_symlink_attacks is false, remain affected, and file flags may still be reset outside of the tree on all platforms.

A security vulnerability has been detected in yangzongzhuan RuoYi up to 4.8.3. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file ruoyi-admin/src/main/java/com/ruoyi/web/controller/system/SysLoginController.java of the component User Registration Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument deptId/status/userId/createBy leads to improper input validation. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The identifier of the patch is d7ad977c9ca64e9b081c893ec56fe08f51f66698. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws targeting Microsoft ecosystems across desktop operating systems, cloud infrastructure, network services, and database platforms. Memory corruption issues such as heap and stack buffer overflows, alongside unsafe deserialization and injection vulnerabilities, remain the primary attack vectors enabling unauthenticated exploitation and lateral movement. The widespread impact spans enterprise endpoints, Azure cloud services, SQL Server instances, and developer toolchains, underscoring an urgent need for comprehensive patching across identity management, web applications, and network infrastructure components.
ai.summary_zh: 今日漏洞态势主要由针对Microsoft生态系统的严重远程代码执行与权限提升缺陷主导，覆盖桌面操作系统、云基础设施、网络服务及数据库平台。堆栈缓冲区溢出等内存损坏问题，以及不安全的反序列化与注入漏洞，仍是实现未认证利用和横向移动的主要攻击向量。其广泛影响波及企业终端、Azure云服务、SQL Server实例及开发者工具链，凸显出在身份管理、Web应用和网络基础设施组件层面进行全面补丁修复的紧迫性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Text Shaping enables remote code execution with a CVSS of 9.8, posing a severe threat to endpoint security through crafted documents or web content.
items.reason_zh: Windows Text Shaping中的堆缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，CVSS评分为9.8，通过构造的文档或网页内容对端点安全构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Search Component allows network-based privilege escalation, compromising user accounts without requiring physical access or local enumeration.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search Component中的释放后使用漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，可在无需物理访问或本地枚举的情况下导致用户账户被攻破。

items.reason_en: Chromium-based Edge browser flaw permits unauthorized privilege elevation via memory corruption, affecting millions of corporate workstations and increasing lateral movement risk.
items.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的Edge浏览器存在缺陷，可通过内存损坏实现未授权的权限提升，影响数百万企业工作站，并增加横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows Media Video Decoder demonstrates high exploitability through malicious media files, commonly delivered via spear-phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Video Decoder中的远程代码执行漏洞具有极高的可利用性，攻击者可通过恶意媒体文件进行利用，此类文件通常通过鱼叉式网络钓鱼攻击投递。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV, allowing network-based command injection that bypasses standard security controls.
items.reason_zh: 据CISA KEV目录显示，该漏洞已在野外被积极利用，允许基于网络的命令注入，从而绕过标准安全控制。

items.reason_en: Extremely high severity (9.8) flaw in MSMQ enabling unauthenticated remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: MSMQ中存在极高严重性（9.8）的漏洞，允许通过网络进行未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical memory corruption in Remote Desktop Gateway Service facilitates network-wide remote code execution attacks.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service中的关键内存损坏漏洞使得全网范围的远程代码执行攻击成为可能。

items.reason_en: Represents a high-volume phishing vector via malicious Excel documents, allowing remote code execution with minimal user interaction.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞通过恶意Excel文档构成大规模网络钓鱼攻击途径，仅需极少用户交互即可实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows OLE allows remote code execution. This critical flaw can be triggered by malicious documents or links, leading to full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows OLE中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致远程代码执行。此关键缺陷可由恶意文档或链接触发，进而导致系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows BitLocker enables remote code execution. Exploitation could bypass disk encryption safeguards and grant attackers persistent access.
items.reason_zh: Windows BitLocker中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。利用该漏洞可绕过磁盘加密防护机制，使攻击者获得持久化访问权限。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel permits remote code execution over a network. Attackers can leverage phishing emails with malicious spreadsheets to trigger this vulnerability.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。攻击者可利用包含恶意电子表格的网络钓鱼邮件触发此漏洞。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Raw Image Extension allows remote code execution. Maliciously crafted images distributed via email or web browsing can exploit this without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Windows Raw Image Extension中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。通过电子邮件或网页浏览分发的恶意构造图像可在无需用户交互的情况下利用此漏洞。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Outlook enables remote code execution over a network, posing a severe threat to end-user workstations through malicious email handling.
items.reason_zh: Outlook中的关键堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，在处理恶意邮件时对终端用户工作站构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows LDAP allows network-based remote code execution, directly compromising core directory services and authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows LDAP中的越界写入漏洞允许基于网络的远程代码执行，直接危及核心目录服务和身份验证基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Print Spooler components facilitates local privilege escalation over a network, affecting widespread enterprise printing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler组件中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的本地权限提升，影响广泛部署的企业打印基础设施。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Remote Desktop Services allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally, significantly impacting remote administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已授权攻击者在本地提升权限，对远程管理流程产生重大影响。

items.reason_en: Critical Active Directory Domain Services authorization flaw enabling unauthorized network code execution, directly compromising enterprise identity infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services中的关键授权缺陷允许未授权的网络代码执行，直接危及企业身份基础设施。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution vulnerability in Windows RRAS service poses a severe risk to network routing and remote access configurations.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS服务中的远程代码执行漏洞对网络路由和远程访问配置构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in BITS allows unauthorized network attackers to execute arbitrary code, leveraging a widely deployed background transfer service.
items.reason_zh: BITS中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经授权的网络攻击者执行任意代码，该漏洞利用了广泛部署的后台传输服务。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server enables network-based code execution, threatening core network address management.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server中的双重释放漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，威胁核心网络地址管理功能。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client permits unauthorized network code execution, directly impacting remote administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行，直接影响远程管理流程。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in RPC Runtime allows unauthenticated network RCE. This is critical due to RPC's pervasive use in Windows environments, enabling rapid lateral movement across corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行。鉴于RPC在Windows环境中广泛使用，该漏洞极为关键，可使攻击者在企业网络中快速横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft XML enables unauthenticated network RCE. Attackers can exploit this via malicious documents or parsed XML feeds to gain full system control without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft XML中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行。攻击者可通过恶意文档或解析的XML数据源利用此漏洞，在无需用户交互的情况下获取完全系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in OpenSSH for Windows allows unauthenticated network RCE. Compromising SSH directly impacts server administration and secure remote access workflows.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows中的相对路径遍历漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行。SSH一旦被攻破，将直接影响服务器管理和安全远程访问流程。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Remote Desktop Client allows network-level tampering and privilege escalation. RDP remains a primary target for ransomware and APT groups, making this highly actionable.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client中缺失身份验证机制，允许网络级篡改和权限提升。RDP仍是勒索软件和APT组织的主要攻击目标，因此该漏洞极具可操作性。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Microsoft Excel enables unauthenticated network RCE. Given Excel's ubiquity in phishing campaigns, this vulnerability poses an immediate mass-exploitation risk.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Excel中的释放后使用漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行。鉴于Excel在网络钓鱼攻击中被广泛使用，该漏洞存在迫在眉睫的大规模利用风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Event Tracing allows unauthenticated network RCE. Exploiting logging services can bypass detection mechanisms while granting full system access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Event Tracing中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行。利用日志记录服务可绕过检测机制，同时授予完全系统访问权限。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI+ enables unauthenticated network RCE. As a core graphics subsystem, GDI+ flaws are frequently weaponized for drive-by attacks and malware delivery.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI+中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行。作为核心图形子系统，GDI+缺陷常被武器化用于驱动下载攻击和恶意软件投放。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Outlook enables remote code execution via network-delivered payloads, presenting a high phishing attack surface.
items.reason_zh: Outlook中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络投递的有效载荷实现远程代码执行，构成了较高的网络钓鱼攻击面。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Partition Management Driver allows unauthenticated remote code execution, exposing a critical kernel component.
items.reason_zh: Partition Management Driver中的越界读取漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，暴露出关键的内核组件。

items.reason_en: SMB Client heap overflow facilitates remote privilege escalation, directly enabling lateral movement across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: SMB Client 堆溢出可导致远程提权，直接实现跨企业网络的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Windows Search Component out-of-bounds write enables remote code execution, leveraging a widely deployed default system feature.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search Component 越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，该漏洞利用了广泛部署的默认系统功能。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting allows remote code execution without authentication, making it a critical target for automated malware campaigns and rapid endpoint compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许无需认证的远程代码执行，使其成为自动化恶意软件攻击和快速攻陷终端的关键目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation enables remote code execution via malicious media files, posing a high risk for drive-by downloads and payload delivery.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意媒体文件实现远程代码执行，对旁路下载和有效载荷投放构成高风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word allows remote code execution through crafted documents, frequently exploited in targeted spear-phishing and macro-based attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过特制文档实现远程代码执行，常被用于定向鱼叉式钓鱼和基于宏的攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows USB Driver permits local privilege escalation when malicious peripherals are connected, highly relevant for physical access or supply chain scenarios.
items.reason_zh: 连接恶意外设时，Windows USB Driver 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地提权，在物理访问或供应链攻击场景中具有高度相关性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows Win32K allows local privilege escalation in kernel mode, widely leveraged by threat actors for full system takeover and persistence.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K 中的释放后使用漏洞允许在内核模式下进行本地提权，威胁行为体广泛利用该漏洞实现完全控制系统和持久化驻留。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Player enables remote code execution. Its 9.8 CVSS score and widespread deployment make it a high-priority target for malware distribution.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Player 中的严重基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。其 9.8 CVSS 评分及广泛部署使其成为恶意软件分发的高优先级目标。

items.reason_en: Bypasses cryptographic signature verification in the Windows RPC runtime, allowing unauthorized remote code execution. This flaw undermines trust boundaries in distributed Windows environments.
items.reason_zh: 绕过 Windows RPC 运行时的加密签名验证，允许未授权的远程代码执行。此缺陷破坏了分布式 Windows 环境中的信任边界。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution. Compromising RDP directly impacts enterprise administrative access and lateral movement capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行。RDP 被攻陷将直接影响企业管理员访问权限和横向移动能力。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables remote code execution via malicious documents. Given the ubiquity of Office, this remains a primary vector for spear-phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行。鉴于 Office 的广泛普及，这仍是鱼叉式钓鱼攻击的主要向量。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Outlook enables remote code execution without user interaction, posing a severe threat to enterprise email environments.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下实现远程代码执行，对企业邮件环境构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Outlook similarly allows remote code execution, highlighting a critical weakness in Microsoft's mail client architecture.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞同样可导致远程代码执行，凸显了 Microsoft 邮件客户端架构中的关键弱点。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 integer overflow in the Windows Raw Image Extension can be triggered remotely via malicious images, affecting a wide range of desktop applications.
items.reason_zh: Windows Raw Image Extension 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意图像远程触发，影响广泛的桌面应用程序。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 use-after-free in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to escalate privileges, directly impacting browser security for millions of users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的释放后使用漏洞允许远程攻击者提权，直接影响数百万用户的浏览器安全性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in LSASS enables remote code execution with a CVSS of 9.8. This directly compromises Windows credential storage and poses an immediate threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的越界写入漏洞（CVSS 9.8）可导致远程代码执行。该漏洞直接破坏 Windows 凭据存储，对终端安全构成即时威胁。

items.reason_en: Use after free in PowerPoint allows remote code execution via malicious documents. High attack value due to frequent phishing campaigns leveraging Office attachments.
items.reason_zh: PowerPoint 中的释放后使用漏洞可通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行。由于频繁利用 Office 附件发起钓鱼攻击，该漏洞具有高攻击价值。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Outlook permits remote code execution. Critical for corporate environments where email remains a primary attack vector.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行。在企业环境中，电子邮件仍是主要攻击向量，因此该漏洞至关重要。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Desktop Window Manager allows local privilege escalation. Important for defending against insider threats and compromised user sessions.
items.reason_zh: Desktop Window Manager 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地提权。对于防御内部威胁和应对已沦陷的用户会话具有重要意义。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Microsoft Office Word enables remote code execution via malicious documents. Its critical 9.8 CVSS score and network exploitability make it a high-priority target for phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的不受信任的指针解引用漏洞可通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行。其关键的 9.8 CVSS 评分和网络可攻击性使其成为钓鱼攻击的高优先级目标。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) enables network-based privilege escalation, directly threatening authentication and credential storage.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) 中的越界读取漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，直接威胁身份验证与凭据存储安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Print Spooler Components allows network-based privilege escalation, continuing the historical risk profile of this widely targeted service.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler Components 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，延续了该广泛受攻击服务的历史风险特征。

items.reason_en: Code injection in the Encrypting File System (EFS) permits network-based code execution, undermining data protection mechanisms and enabling full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Encrypting File System (EFS) 中的代码注入漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，破坏数据保护机制并导致系统被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows unauthenticated remote code execution, posing significant risks to organizations relying on RDP for remote access.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的堆溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，对依赖RDP进行远程访问的组织构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect numeric type conversion in Microsoft JScript enables unauthenticated remote code execution, affecting web applications and scripts processing user-controlled input.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中的不正确数值类型转换漏洞可启用未经身份验证的远程代码执行，影响处理用户可控输入的Web应用和脚本。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in VOLSNAP.SYS allows network-based privilege escalation, potentially exposing sensitive volume shadow copies to unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: VOLSNAP.SYS 中的越界读取漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，可能导致敏感卷影副本暴露于未授权访问之下。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in NTFS enables network-based privilege escalation, risking file system integrity and allowing unauthorized data manipulation.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 中的越界读取漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，危及文件系统完整性并允许未授权的数据篡改。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the HID Parser Library allows network-based privilege escalation, impacting systems with connected peripheral devices exposed to network protocols.
items.reason_zh: HID Parser Library 中的整数下溢漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，影响连接了暴露于网络协议的外围设备的系统。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in OpenSSH for Windows permits unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising secure shell access and associated server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中的堆溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接破坏安全Shell访问及相关服务器基础设施。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Windows DHCP Server allows unauthenticated network denial of service, disrupting critical IP address management and connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的越界读取漏洞可导致未经身份验证的网络拒绝服务，中断关键的IP地址管理与网络连接。

items.reason_en: Critical stack-based buffer overflow in DirectMusic enables unauthorized remote code execution with a CVSS of 9.8, posing an immediate threat to endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: DirectMusic 中的严重基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞（CVSS 9.8）可启用未授权的远程代码执行，对终端完整性构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Severe integer underflow in PowerShell allows attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network (CVSS 9.8), bypassing standard sandbox restrictions.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 中的严重整数下溢漏洞允许攻击者通过网络执行任意代码（CVSS 9.8），从而绕过标准沙箱限制。

items.reason_en: High-severity stack-based buffer overflow in the Win32K subsystem permits local privilege escalation via network-accessible triggers (CVSS 8.0).
items.reason_zh: Win32K subsystem 中的高危基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过网络可访问的触发条件实现本地权限提升（CVSS 8.0）。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation risk due to a stack-based buffer overflow in the Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) module, which protects credential validation.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) 模块中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞会导致本地权限提升风险，该模块负责保护凭据验证过程。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path vulnerability in Windows Update could allow local privilege escalation by forcing the system to load malicious DLLs during patching.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update 中的不受信任的搜索路径漏洞可能在打补丁期间强制系统加载恶意DLL，从而导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows USB Mass Storage Class Driver allows unauthorized network code execution, severely compromising system integrity and peripheral security.
items.reason_zh: Windows USB Mass Storage Class Driver 中的CVSS 9.8基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的网络代码执行，严重破坏系统完整性与外设安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables unauthorized network code execution, directly threatening remote administration sessions and endpoint access.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的CVSS 8.8基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用未授权的网络代码执行，直接威胁远程管理会话与终端访问。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 integer underflow in the Windows Codecs Library permits unauthorized network code execution by exploiting common image processing workflows used across desktop applications.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的CVSS 8.8整数下溢漏洞通过利用跨桌面应用程序常用的图像处理工作流，允许未授权的网络代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows ALPC is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), allowing local privilege escalation through flawed inter-process communication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows ALPC 中的CVSS 7.8基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞已在野外被积极利用（列入CISA KEV），可通过有缺陷的进程间通信机制实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Rich Text Edit Control allows remote unauthenticated code execution via crafted documents. Its high CVSS and broad user base make it a critical threat for endpoint compromise.
items.reason_zh: Rich Text Edit Control 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过构造的文档实现远程未认证代码执行。其高CVSS评分与广泛的用户基础使其成为终端被入侵的关键威胁。

items.reason_en: Vulnerability in Windows Schannel enables remote code execution over the network due to a heap-based buffer overflow. This directly compromises TLS/SSL communications, posing severe risks to encrypted traffic integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 中的漏洞因基于堆的缓冲区溢出而允许网络远程代码执行。这将直接破坏TLS/SSL通信，对加密流量完整性构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Remote desktop client heap overflow permits unauthenticated network-based code execution. Given RDP's ubiquitous use for administrative access, successful exploitation leads to full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 的堆溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的基于网络的代码执行。鉴于RDP在管理访问中的普遍使用，成功利用将导致系统被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Outlook allows remote code execution via malicious emails or attachments. As a widely deployed email client, this flaw facilitates widespread phishing-driven malware delivery.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意邮件或附件实现远程代码执行。作为广泛部署的电子邮件客户端，此缺陷助长了基于钓鱼的恶意软件大规模投递。

items.reason_en: Incomplete comparison in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized bypass of security features over the network. Developers relying on IDE security controls face significant risk of environment tampering or data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的不完整比较漏洞允许通过网络未经授权绕过安全功能。依赖 IDE 安全控制的开发人员面临环境被篡改或数据泄露的重大风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based use-after-free in Windows Remote Desktop Services enables unauthorized network RCE, posing a severe threat to remote administration workflows and enterprise endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Services 中的基于堆的释放后使用漏洞可导致未经授权的远程网络代码执行，对远程管理流程和企业终端构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Windows AppX Deployment Extensions allows local privilege escalation, effectively bypassing UAC and standard security boundaries for arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows AppX Deployment Extensions 中缺失授权检查可导致本地权限提升，有效绕过 UAC 和标准安全边界以执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows SMB permits network-based privilege escalation, facilitating rapid lateral movement across unpatched corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 中的竞争条件漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，助长在未修补的企业网络中快速进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Critical Active Directory Netlogon component flaw enabling remote code execution; poses severe risk to domain controller integrity and enterprise authentication.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Netlogon 组件存在关键缺陷，可导致远程代码执行；对域控制器完整性和企业身份验证构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Word allows remote code execution via malicious documents, leveraging the application's widespread enterprise deployment.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Word 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行，利用该应用在企业中的广泛部署扩大攻击面。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Distributed File System enables privilege escalation over network shares, compromising server-side file storage security.
items.reason_zh: Distributed File System 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可借助网络共享实现权限提升，破坏服务器端文件存储安全。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Hyper-V permits local code execution by authorized users, potentially destabilizing virtualized workloads and host isolation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的堆溢出漏洞允许授权用户执行本地代码，可能导致虚拟化工作负载不稳定及主机隔离失效。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized resource in Windows RDP allows remote code execution, posing a critical threat to remote administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows RDP 中的未初始化资源漏洞可导致远程代码执行，对远程管理流程构成关键威胁。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows Server Network driver enables unauthorized network-based code execution, impacting core OS networking stability.
items.reason_zh: Windows Server Network 驱动程序中的竞争条件漏洞可导致未经授权的基于网络的代码执行，影响操作系统核心网络稳定性。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Remote Desktop facilitates remote code execution, directly targeting widely used administrative protocols.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，直接针对广泛使用的管理协议。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the SMB transport driver (srvnet.sys) allows remote attackers to execute code, enabling lateral movement across networks.
items.reason_zh: SMB 传输驱动程序（srvnet.sys）中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者执行代码，从而实现跨网络的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library enables unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious media files, significantly increasing phishing and triage attack surfaces.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意媒体文件实现未认证的远程代码执行，显著增加钓鱼和初步分析阶段的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Paint allows unauthenticated remote code execution, exploiting a universally installed system utility to bypass perimeter defenses.
items.reason_zh: Paint 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现未认证的远程代码执行，利用普遍安装的系统工具绕过边界防御。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the WebP Image Extension permits unauthenticated remote code execution, targeting modern image processing pipelines used across enterprise endpoints.
items.reason_zh: WebP Image Extension 中的整数溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，针对企业终端广泛使用的现代图像处理流水线。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft Word enables unauthenticated local code execution, frequently leveraged in malicious document distribution campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Word 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现未认证的本地代码执行，常被用于恶意文档分发活动。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft Access allows unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening legacy database workflows and macro-based automation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Access 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致未认证的远程代码执行，威胁传统数据库工作流程及基于宏的自动化操作。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution vulnerability in the RPC Runtime affects all supported Windows versions, enabling unauthenticated network attacks.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中存在关键远程代码执行漏洞，影响所有受支持的 Windows 版本，可实现未认证的网络攻击。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in the iSCSI Target Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution, impacting storage networking infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI Target Service 中存在关键堆溢出漏洞，可导致未认证的远程代码执行，影响存储网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in the Windows Network File System enables remote code execution without prior authentication.
items.reason_zh: Windows Network File System 中存在高危堆溢出漏洞，可在无需预先认证的情况下实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Credential Providers allows remote code execution during user login and authentication workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Credential Providers 中的堆溢出漏洞允许在用户登录和身份验证流程期间执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows iSCSI component permits remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 组件中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in the .NET Framework can be exploited to bypass security restrictions and achieve local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的相对路径遍历漏洞可被利用以绕过安全限制并实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Win32K driver allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 驱动程序中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Local Security Authority Server (LSASS) poses a severe risk for credential theft and local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server (LSASS) 中的堆溢出漏洞对凭证窃取和本地权限提升构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Link Layer Topology Discovery Protocol enables remote code execution on affected Windows endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Link Layer Topology Discovery Protocol 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致受影响 Windows 终端上的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the NTFS driver allows local attackers to execute code with elevated system privileges.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地攻击者以提权的系统权限执行代码。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in the Windows Install Service permits local privilege escalation by authorized users during software deployment.
items.reason_zh: Windows Install Service 中的释放后使用漏洞允许授权用户在软件部署期间实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Memory release vulnerability in the TCP/IP stack can be leveraged to trigger denial-of-service conditions on networked systems.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈中的内存释放漏洞可被利用以在网络系统上触发拒绝服务状态。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in the IKE Extension impacts VPN connectivity and creates a reliable denial-of-service vector.
items.reason_zh: IKE Extension 中的空指针解引用漏洞会影响 VPN 连接，并构成可靠的拒绝服务攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows DNS service enables network-based denial-of-service attacks against critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 服务中的整数溢出可针对关键名称解析基础设施实施基于网络的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in Kerberos implementation allows unauthorized denial-of-service attacks across domain networks.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos 实现中的空指针解引用允许在域网络上发起未授权的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Print Spooler components facilitates local privilege escalation on print-enabled workstations and servers.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler 组件中的释放后使用漏洞可导致启用打印功能的终端和服务器发生本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Universal Disk Format File System Driver enables local privilege escalation for authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: Universal Disk Format 文件系统驱动程序中的堆溢出可使已认证用户实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Credential Providers allows local privilege escalation during interactive authentication sessions.
items.reason_zh: Windows 凭据提供程序中的堆溢出可在交互式身份验证会话期间导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the NTFS driver permits local privilege escalation over the network when mounted volumes are accessed.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出在访问已挂载卷时可通过网络实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation error in Kerberos enables local privilege escalation for authorized domain users.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos 中的数值截断错误可使授权域用户实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Windows Kernel allows authenticated attackers to bypass security boundaries and elevate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的不当访问控制允许已认证攻击者绕过安全边界并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Message Queuing enables local privilege escalation for authenticated network service accounts.
items.reason_zh: Windows 消息队列中的堆溢出可使已认证的网络服务账户实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Spaceport.sys permits local privilege escalation on devices utilizing virtual disk management features.
items.reason_zh: Spaceport.sys 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可使使用虚拟磁盘管理功能的设备发生本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Virtual Hard Disk miniport driver allows local privilege escalation over the network when VHDs are mounted.
items.reason_zh: 虚拟硬盘微型端口驱动程序中的堆溢出在挂载 VHD 时可通过网络实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows Group Policy enables local privilege escalation over the network during policy processing.
items.reason_zh: Windows 组策略中的不受信任的指针解引用在策略处理期间可通过网络实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Remote Desktop Services allows unauthorized network RCE, posing a critical threat due to widespread RDP deployment.
items.reason_zh: 远程桌面服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行，由于 RDP 部署广泛，构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Compressed folder heap overflow enables network RCE, compromising core Windows file extraction mechanisms used across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: 压缩文件夹的堆溢出可实现网络远程代码执行，破坏企业环境中广泛使用的核心 Windows 文件提取机制。

items.reason_en: Windows kernel use-after-free allows local privilege escalation, directly undermining core OS security boundaries and isolation models.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，直接破坏核心操作系统的安全边界与隔离模型。

items.reason_en: Active Directory Certificate Services improper authorization enables network privilege escalation, threatening enterprise PKI and certificate issuance workflows.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory 证书服务的不当授权可实现网络权限提升，威胁企业 PKI 及证书颁发工作流。

items.reason_en: Windows OLE type confusion allows network RCE, leveraging common COM/Office exploitation vectors to bypass security controls.
items.reason_zh: Windows OLE 的类型混淆可导致网络远程代码执行，利用常见的 COM/Office 利用向量绕过安全控制。

items.reason_en: Active Directory Domain Services use-after-free permits network RCE, directly endangering domain controller integrity and identity infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory 域服务的释放后使用漏洞允许网络远程代码执行，直接危及域控制器完整性与身份基础设施。

items.reason_en: NTFS out-of-bounds read allows network privilege escalation, affecting fundamental file system driver operations and memory safety.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 的越界读取可实现网络权限提升，影响基础文件系统驱动程序操作与内存安全。

items.reason_en: Windows Error Reporting out-of-bounds read enables local privilege escalation, exploiting diagnostic service memory handling routines.
items.reason_zh: Windows 错误报告的越界读取可利用诊断服务内存处理例程实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: NTFS out-of-bounds read allows local privilege escalation, impacting file system driver stability and local security posture.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 的越界读取可导致本地权限提升，影响文件系统驱动程序稳定性与本地安全态势。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Windows Shell enables local privilege escalation, bypassing shell integrity checks for elevated execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中缺失的身份验证可实现本地权限提升，绕过 Shell 完整性检查以进行提权执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Telnet Client enables remote code execution over the network with a CVSS of 9.8, posing a critical risk for legacy network administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Telnet 客户端中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可引发网络远程代码执行（CVSS 评分为 9.8），对传统网络管理工作流构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, severely threatening enterprise network infrastructure reliability.

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows Media Foundation permits remote code execution over the network, impacting multimedia processing pipelines across modern Windows deployments.

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in Azure Data Factory undermines data pipeline security by allowing unauthorized privilege elevation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Data Factory 中的密码学签名验证绕过漏洞允许未授权权限提升，破坏数据管道安全。

items.reason_en: Modification of assumed-immutable data in Azure Active Directory enables privilege escalation, threatening core identity management and tenant security.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中修改假定不可变数据的行为可触发提权，威胁核心身份管理与租户安全。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthenticated privilege escalation, jeopardizing container orchestration and cloud-native workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中缺乏身份验证可导致未认证提权，危及容器编排与云原生工作负载。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.9 SSRF in Azure OpenAI allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, directly compromising cloud AI service isolation and tenant security.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中存在 CVSS 9.9 分的 SSRF 漏洞，允许已认证攻击者通过网络提升权限，直接破坏云 AI 服务隔离性与租户安全。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Exchange Online enables privilege escalation over the network, posing a severe risk to enterprise email infrastructure and data governance.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Online 中缺乏授权控制可实现网络提权，对企业邮件基础设施与数据治理构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: XSS in Dynamics 365 Customer Voice facilitates spoofing attacks that undermine user trust and can lead to credential harvesting or session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 Customer Voice 中的 XSS 漏洞易受欺骗攻击影响，损害用户信任，并可能导致凭证窃取或会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Perfect-score authentication bypass in Azure Active Directory allows unauthorized privilege escalation, directly threatening enterprise identity management.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的身份验证完全绕过漏洞允许未授权提权，直接威胁企业身份管理体系。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Azure Kubernetes Service enables local code execution within container orchestration environments, risking cluster compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中的路径遍历漏洞可在容器编排环境中实现本地代码执行，导致集群面临被攻陷风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in M365 Copilot allows unauthenticated network actors to exfiltrate sensitive information from the cloud productivity suite.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 中缺乏身份验证机制，允许未认证网络实体从云生产力套件中窃取敏感信息。

items.reason_en: A flawed app validation workflow in Splunk SOAR executes untrusted code on the host, enabling complete compromise of the security orchestration platform.
items.reason_zh: Splunk SOAR 中缺陷的应用程序验证工作流会在宿主机上执行不受信任的代码，致使安全编排平台遭完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: The Okta .NET SDK fails to restrict outbound requests to the organization domain, risking the leakage of sensitive API tokens to external hosts.
items.reason_zh: Okta .NET SDK 未将出站请求限制于组织域名内，存在敏感 API 令牌泄露至外部主机的风险。

items.reason_en: Code injection in the ServiceNow AI Platform allows authenticated template editors to execute arbitrary code within other users' browser sessions.
items.reason_zh: ServiceNow AI Platform 中的代码注入漏洞允许已认证模板编辑者在其他用户的浏览器会话中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Shell metacharacters in Dokploy's PaaS build directory settings bypass sanitization, allowing authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands in containerized environments.
items.reason_zh: Dokploy PaaS 构建目录配置中的 Shell 元字符可绕过过滤机制，允许已认证用户在容器化环境中执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Prototype pollution via crafted SOAP XML requests can destabilize Node.js cloud middleware and disrupt downstream API services.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的 SOAP XML 请求触发的原型链污染可导致 Node.js 云中间件运行异常，并中断下游 API 服务。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service grants attackers full administrative control over virtualized cloud infrastructure and tenants.
items.reason_zh: VMware Directory Service 中的身份验证绕过漏洞使攻击者获得对虚拟化云基础设施及租户的完全管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Command injection in OpenStack Cinder's SSH storage driver allows volume owners to execute arbitrary commands on underlying compute hosts.
items.reason_zh: OpenStack Cinder 的 SSH 存储驱动中存在命令注入漏洞，允许卷所有者在底层计算主机上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Inconsistent WebSocket authorization in the Dokploy PaaS enables unauthenticated access to arbitrary containers, logs, and monitoring endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Dokploy PaaS 中 WebSocket 授权校验不一致，导致未认证用户可访问任意容器、日志及监控端点。

items.reason_en: Username handling flaws in TeamCity token authentication allow privilege escalation to administrator roles within CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: TeamCity 令牌认证中的用户名处理缺陷可导致 CI/CD 流水线中的权限提升至管理员级别。

items.reason_en: Critically exploited RCE in widely deployed NAS operating systems allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via improper input encoding.
items.reason_zh: 广泛部署的 NAS 操作系统中存在高危 RCE 漏洞，远程攻击者可利用不当的输入编码执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in migration headers allows controlled sources to create root-owned volumes outside intended directories, compromising host isolation.
items.reason_zh: 迁移请求头中的路径遍历漏洞允许恶意源在目标目录外创建 root 权限卷，破坏主机隔离性。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass allows restricted clients to create bridge networks with raw directives, executing code as root on the host.
items.reason_zh: 授权绕过漏洞允许受限客户端使用原始指令创建桥接网络，从而以 root 权限在宿主机上执行代码。

items.reason_en: Inadequate password sanitization allows backtick injection into Bash commands, enabling authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: 密码过滤机制不完善导致反引号可注入 Bash 命令，使已认证攻击者能够执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: An authorization bypass in the shared-drive move handler allows authenticated users to access cross-instance files by manipulating directory identifiers, compromising multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: 共享驱动器迁移处理器中的授权绕过漏洞允许已认证用户通过篡改目录标识符访问跨实例文件，破坏多租户隔离性。

items.reason_en: An integer underflow in Dell PowerStore's cryptographic service implementation can trigger denial-of-service conditions, threatening cloud storage reliability and data protection mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerStore 加密服务实现中的整数下溢漏洞可触发拒绝服务（DoS）状态，危及云存储可靠性与数据保护机制。

items.reason_en: Broken cryptographic validation in the Cloudflare Zero Trust strategy allows unauthenticated impersonation of service tokens, breaching cloud identity boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Cloudflare Zero Trust 策略中加密验证逻辑缺陷允许未认证伪造服务令牌，突破云身份安全边界。

items.reason_en: Gas cost multiplier abuse forces sponsors to cover unauthorized provisioning expenses, exploiting financial logic in cloud-based payment channels.
items.reason_zh: 燃料费乘数滥用迫使交易赞助方承担未授权的资源配置费用，利用了云端支付通道的财务逻辑缺陷。

items.reason_en: Trusting unverified TLS certificates in WebSocket clients exposes AI session tokens to interception, compromising cloud AI service integrations.
items.reason_zh: WebSocket 客户端盲目信任未经验证的 TLS 证书，导致 AI 会话令牌面临中间人拦截风险，破坏云 AI 服务集成安全。

items.reason_en: Missing binding between authorization credentials and chain context allows credential reuse, draining payer funds in cloud micro-payment systems.
items.reason_zh: 授权凭证与链上下文间缺乏绑定机制导致凭证可被重复使用，进而耗尽云微支付系统中的付款方资金。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 Oracle Access Manager Authentication Engine flaw allows unauthenticated HTTP-based compromise of critical identity and access management services.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 10.0 分的 Oracle Access Manager 身份验证引擎缺陷允许未认证攻击者通过 HTTP 协议攻陷关键身份与访问管理服务。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.9 Jet Admin Cloud Platform prompt injection vulnerability allows free-tier users to expose sensitive .env configuration files and exfiltrate credentials.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.9 分的 Jet Admin Cloud Platform 提示词注入漏洞允许免费套餐用户泄露敏感 .env 配置文件并窃取凭证。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 gosaml2 SAML implementation flaw skips signature validation before decryption, creating a pathway for encrypted assertion forgery and authentication bypass.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 分的 gosaml2 SAML 实现缺陷在解密前跳过签名验证，为加密断言伪造及身份验证绕过提供攻击路径。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in DNS Server enables remote code execution, potentially disrupting critical network name resolution infrastructure and enabling cache poisoning attacks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，可能破坏关键网络名称解析基础设施并引发缓存投毒攻击。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Network Policy Server allows unauthenticated RCE, jeopardizing enterprise network access control mechanisms and 802.1X authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server 中的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权远程代码执行，危及企业网络访问控制机制及 802.1X 认证流程。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in OpenSSH for Windows facilitates remote code execution, undermining secure remote administration channels and IT operations workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 中的释放后使用漏洞可促成远程代码执行，破坏安全远程管理通道及 IT 运维工作流。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows Schannel enables remote code execution, breaking TLS encryption guarantees and exposing internal communication channels to interception.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏 TLS 加密保障并使内部通信信道面临被窃听风险。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution. DHCP services are critical infrastructure targets, making this flaw particularly dangerous for network availability.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行。DHCP 服务是关键基础设施目标，此缺陷对网络可用性构成极大威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution. Similar to the previous flaw, it threatens network integrity and can be exploited remotely.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。与前述缺陷类似，该漏洞威胁网络完整性且可被远程利用。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows SMB allows remote code execution. SMB is widely used for file sharing, providing a prime attack vector for lateral movement in enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。SMB 广泛用于文件共享，为企业网络中的横向移动提供了主要攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Missing reference to active allocated resource in Windows SMB Server causes denial of service. This flaw can disrupt network connectivity and file sharing services for connected clients.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server 中缺失对已分配活跃资源的引用会导致拒绝服务。此缺陷可能中断连接客户端的网络连通性及文件共享服务。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the DNS Server component allows network-based remote code execution, jeopardizing critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 组件中的非信任指针解引用漏洞可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，危及关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in the Network Device Enrollment Service permits remote code execution, undermining secure device onboarding and certificate management.
items.reason_zh: Network Device Enrollment Service 中的弱认证漏洞允许远程代码执行，破坏安全的设备入网及证书管理流程。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows Deployment Services enables remote code execution, impacting network-based operating system provisioning and imaging.
items.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，影响基于网络的操作系统配置与镜像部署。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in DNS Server allows unauthenticated network RCE. DNS infrastructure compromise can disrupt enterprise name resolution and facilitate man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的非信任指针解引用漏洞可导致未授权的网络远程代码执行。DNS 基础设施遭入侵将破坏企业名称解析并助长中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Release of invalid pointer in DNS Server allows authenticated network RCE. While requiring authentication, DNS server compromises provide critical network reconnaissance and traffic redirection capabilities.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的无效指针释放漏洞可导致需认证的远程代码执行。尽管需要认证，但 DNS 服务器遭入侵可提供关键的网络侦察与流量重定向能力。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution. Disrupting or hijacking DHCP services severely impacts network availability and IP allocation.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。干扰或劫持 DHCP 服务会严重影响网络可用性与 IP 地址分配。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the DNS Server enables remote code execution. Exploiting this flaw jeopardizes fundamental name resolution services across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的非信任指针解引用漏洞可导致远程代码执行。利用此缺陷将危及企业网络中的基础名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Network Policy Server allows remote code execution. This directly impacts network authentication, authorization, and accounting infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。该漏洞直接影响网络认证、授权与计费基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 Kerberos authentication bypass allows network-based privilege escalation, striking at the core of Windows domain security protocols.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 9.8 的 Kerberos 认证绕过漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，直接冲击 Windows 域安全协议的核心。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services enables remote code execution, jeopardizing central directory infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 8.8 的 Active Directory Domain Services 错误授权漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及核心目录基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 weak authentication in Exchange Server facilitates privilege escalation, maintaining high relevance for corporate email infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 8.8 的 Exchange Server 弱认证漏洞可促成权限提升，对企业邮件基础设施安全保持高度相关性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Message Queuing allows remote code execution, impacting distributed messaging architectures.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 8.1 的 Windows Message Queuing 基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，影响分布式消息传递架构。

items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的缓冲区大小计算错误可导致远程代码执行。该漏洞使存储区域网络及关键数据基础设施面临被远程接管的风险。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows iSCSI permits remote code execution. Compounds storage network risks by enabling unauthorized control over SAN communications.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行。该漏洞通过赋予攻击者对 SAN 通信的未授权控制权，加剧了存储网络风险。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows DNS allows remote information disclosure. Threatens network resolution reliability and can aid reconnaissance attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致远程信息泄露。该漏洞威胁网络解析可靠性，并可辅助侦察攻击。

items.reason_en: Stack overflow in the Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution by unauthenticated attackers, disrupting critical IP address management and network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的栈溢出漏洞可使未授权攻击者实现远程代码执行，破坏关键的 IP 地址管理与网络连通性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in OpenSSH for Windows allows remote code execution over the network, severely impacting secure administrative access channels.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 中的释放后使用漏洞可通过网络实现远程代码执行，严重破坏安全的管理访问通道。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows VMSwitch can lead to local privilege escalation within virtual switch environments, affecting modern cloud and enterprise networking stacks.

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in DHCP Server grants attackers full control over critical network address assignment services.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的堆溢出漏洞使攻击者能够完全控制关键的网络地址分配服务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, disrupting core name resolution.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程攻击者执行任意代码，破坏核心名称解析功能。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in RRAS compromises routing and remote access capabilities, enabling lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: RRAS 中的远程代码执行漏洞会破坏路由与远程访问功能，从而支持横向移动。

items.reason_zh: SMB Client 中的释放后使用漏洞可在常规文件共享操作期间启用基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in HTTP Print Provider allows remote attackers to execute code over the network, targeting shared printers.
items.reason_zh: HTTP Print Provider 中的堆溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者在网络上执行代码，主要针对共享打印机。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Windows DHCP Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening critical network infrastructure and IP management services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的越界读取漏洞可导致未认证远程代码执行，威胁关键网络基础设施与 IP 管理服务。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Remote Desktop Gateway Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution, exposing vital remote access gateways to full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 中的双重释放漏洞可导致未认证远程代码执行，使关键远程访问网关面临系统完全失陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows DNS permits unauthenticated network spoofing, disrupting name resolution and facilitating man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的源验证错误允许未认证网络欺骗，干扰名称解析并促成中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows DNS allows unauthorized information disclosure over a network, potentially leaking sensitive internal configuration and routing data.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的越界读取漏洞可导致网络范围内的未授权信息泄露，可能暴露敏感的内部配置与路由数据。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 DNS server heap overflow allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely, destabilizing critical name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 DNS 服务器堆溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行代码，危及关键名称解析服务的稳定性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 DHCP server heap overflow allows authenticated attackers to execute code remotely, potentially disrupting network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 DHCP 服务器堆溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行代码，可能导致网络连接中断。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 DNS server use-after-free permits unauthenticated remote code execution, targeting widely deployed network infrastructure.

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 Active Directory use-after-free enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly threatening identity management systems.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 的 Active Directory 释放后使用漏洞可导致未认证远程代码执行，直接威胁身份管理系统。

items.reason_en: Type confusion flaw in the DNS Server enables remote code execution over the network (CVSS 8.8), directly impacting critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的类型混淆漏洞允许通过网络远程执行代码（CVSS 8.8），直接影响关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the DHCP Server allows unauthorized remote code execution (CVSS 8.8), potentially compromising entire subnet IP allocation services.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的整数溢出漏洞允许未授权远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8），可能危及整个子网的 IP 分配服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server poses a significant remote code execution risk (CVSS 8.1) due to widespread deployment in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: 由于在企业环境中广泛部署，DNS Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞带来严重的远程代码执行风险（CVSS 8.1）。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in Microsoft QUIC service leads to remote denial of service (CVSS 7.5), disrupting modern encrypted transport protocols.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 服务中的空指针解引用漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务（CVSS 7.5），影响现代加密传输协议的正常运行。

items.reason_zh: .NET 保护机制失效可导致本地远程代码执行（RCE），绕过内置框架安全控制及沙箱限制。

items.reason_en: .NET incorrect authorization allows network security bypass, weakening application-level access enforcement and privilege boundaries.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的授权不正确漏洞可导致网络安全绕过，削弱应用级访问控制及权限边界。

items.reason_en: Hyper-V heap overflow enables local privilege escalation, posing risks to virtualization host security and guest isolation.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，对虚拟化主机安全性及客户机隔离构成风险。

items.reason_en: Windows Clipboard Server use-after-free allows local privilege escalation, exploiting shared data exchange mechanisms between processes.
items.reason_zh: Windows Clipboard Server 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，利用进程间共享的数据交换机制。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Code enables remote code execution that compromises developer environments and source code integrity.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的代码注入漏洞可实现远程代码执行，危及开发环境及源代码完整性。

items.reason_en: Symlink following flaw in Microsoft PC Manager allows local privilege escalation on endpoint management utilities.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft PC Manager 中的符号链接跟踪漏洞可导致终端管理工具发生本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Resilient File System driver creates a direct local code execution attack vector.
items.reason_zh: 弹性文件系统（Resilient File System）驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可直接作为本地代码执行的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution over networks, endangering developer workstations and automated CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，危及开发工作站和自动化 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Failing open in Visual Studio Code permits network security feature bypass, exposing development environments to unauthorized access and tool misuse.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 的故障开放（Failing open）机制可绕过网络安全功能，使开发环境暴露于未授权访问和工具滥用风险中。

items.reason_en: Security feature bypass in VS Code Copilot Chat Extension allows network exploitation, impacting AI-assisted development workflows and code safety.
items.reason_zh: VS Code Copilot Chat 扩展中的安全功能绕过漏洞允许网络攻击利用，影响 AI 辅助开发工作流与代码安全性。

items.reason_en: Active Directory Certificate Services use-after-free enables remote code execution, jeopardizing PKI infrastructure and certificate issuance integrity.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory 证书服务中的释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及 PKI 基础设施及证书颁发的完整性。

items.reason_en: LSA heap overflow allows remote code execution, directly attacking Windows authentication mechanisms and enabling credential theft or bypass.
items.reason_zh: LSA 堆溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接攻击 Windows 身份验证机制，并可能导致凭证窃取或绕过。

items.reason_en: LDAP use-after-free vulnerability permits remote code execution, facilitating unauthorized directory queries and replication attacks against identity stores.
items.reason_zh: LDAP 释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞允许远程代码执行，助长针对身份存储库的未授权目录查询与复制攻击。

items.reason_en: Kerberos heap overflow weakens ticket-granting operations, potentially enabling pass-the-ticket attacks and unauthorized lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos 堆溢出漏洞削弱了票据授予操作，可能启用传递票据（pass-the-ticket）攻击及未授权的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in the License Manager allows local privilege escalation, bypassing critical software licensing controls to execute unauthorized processes.
items.reason_zh: License Manager 中缺失身份验证漏洞可导致本地权限提升，绕过关键软件许可控制以执行未授权进程。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Visual Studio Code permits local code execution, threatening developer toolchains, IDE environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的命令注入漏洞允许本地代码执行，威胁开发者工具链、IDE 环境及 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Nuance PowerScribe allows unauthorized remote code execution, critically impacting healthcare voice recognition and documentation systems.
items.reason_zh: Nuance PowerScribe 中对不受信任数据进行反序列化可导致未授权的远程代码执行，严重影响医疗语音识别与文档系统。

items.reason_en: Elevation of privilege in Microsoft Defender Malware Protection Engine ('RoguePlanet') compromises endpoint detection capabilities, reducing overall organizational security posture.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Defender 恶意软件保护引擎（'RoguePlanet'）中的权限提升漏洞会损害端点检测能力，降低组织整体安全态势。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild, this vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution via MLflow's webhook testing endpoint, posing immediate threat to AI/ML pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已在现实环境中被积极利用，可通过 MLflow 的 Webhook 测试端点实现未认证的远程代码执行，对 AI/ML 流水线构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in samtools HTSlib's BCF reader can trigger crashes or potential exploitation during bioinformatics file processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: samtools HTSlib 的 BCF 读取器中存在整数溢出漏洞，可能在生物信息学文件处理流水线中触发崩溃或潜在利用。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in the Temenos TAFJ log viewer permits authenticated attackers to read arbitrary files on core banking application servers.
items.reason_zh: Temenos TAFJ 日志查看器中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证的攻击者读取核心银行应用服务器上的任意文件。

items.reason_en: Git LFS improperly formats SSH URL paths, allowing shell metacharacter escape that can redirect object transfers or leak authentication credentials.
items.reason_zh: Git LFS 对 SSH URL 路径的格式化不当会导致 Shell 元字符逃逸，从而可能重定向对象传输或泄露认证凭据。

items.reason_en: Path traversal during Ansible collection installation allows malicious packages to overwrite arbitrary host directories due to unvalidated metadata.
items.reason_zh: Ansible 集合安装过程中的路径遍历漏洞因未验证元数据，允许恶意包覆盖主机上的任意目录。

items.reason_en: Unbounded regex processing in NLTK text search functions enables severe denial-of-service attacks on natural language processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: NLTK 文本搜索函数中的无界正则表达式处理漏洞可对自然语言处理流水线造成严重的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Macro expansion in source RPM basenames triggers arbitrary command execution during package relocation, affecting Linux distribution packaging systems.
items.reason_zh: 源 RPM 基本文件名中的宏展开会在包重定位期间触发任意命令执行，影响 Linux 发行版的打包系统。

items.reason_en: Trusting compromised intermediate CA certificates in package registry connections enables network attackers to intercept and serve forged packages.
items.reason_zh: 在软件包注册表连接中信任被攻陷的中间 CA 证书，会使网络攻击者能够拦截并提供伪造的软件包。

items.reason_en: Array index partially controlled by data in experimental decoders causes buffer overflows, risking memory corruption in genomic data processing.
items.reason_zh: 实验性解码器中部分受数据控制的数组索引会导致缓冲区溢出，危及基因组数据处理过程中的内存安全。

items.reason_en: Repository management privileges allow shell syntax injection through URI parameters, leading to command execution on the hosting server.
items.reason_zh: 仓库管理权限允许通过 URI 参数注入 Shell 语法，导致在托管服务器上执行命令。

items.reason_en: A concurrency-related use-after-free flaw in the Linux kernel's NFS server can lead to kernel panics or privilege escalation, affecting a wide range of server and desktop deployments.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 NFS 服务器中与并发相关的释放后使用（use-after-free）漏洞可能导致内核崩溃或权限提升，影响广泛的服务器与桌面部署。

items.reason_en: Erlang/OTP SSL clients fail to validate that the negotiated cipher suite matches the client's offered list, creating a downgrade attack vector that compromises encrypted communications.
items.reason_zh: Erlang/OTP SSL 客户端未能验证协商的密码套件是否与客户端提供的列表匹配，从而形成降级攻击向量，破坏加密通信安全。

items.reason_en: Lack of duplicate detection in the Dropbox Samly SAML validation logic allows attackers to capture and resubmit assertions to authenticate as other users, breaking identity federation security.
items.reason_zh: Dropbox Samly 的 SAML 验证逻辑中缺乏重复检测机制，允许攻击者捕获并重放断言以冒充其他用户进行认证，破坏身份联合安全。

items.reason_en: VCS root argument injection enables unauthenticated RCE in CI/CD pipelines, jeopardizing software supply chain security.
items.reason_zh: VCS 根参数注入漏洞可在 CI/CD 流水线中实现未认证的远程代码执行，危及软件供应链安全。

items.reason_en: Malicious build attributes execute arbitrary commands during automated compilation, allowing attackers to compromise development environments.
items.reason_zh: 恶意构建属性会在自动编译期间执行任意命令，使攻击者得以入侵开发环境。

items.reason_en: Artifact cache path traversal permits reading and writing arbitrary files, escalating to remote code execution in build agents.
items.reason_zh: 制品缓存的路径遍历漏洞允许读写任意文件，并可能在构建代理中升级为远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Git dependency name sanitization flaw allows directory traversal during package resolution, enabling arbitrary filesystem modification.
items.reason_zh: Git 依赖项名称清理漏洞在包解析过程中允许目录遍历，从而导致任意文件系统修改。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 BZFlag game server flaw features a heap out-of-bounds write allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to corrupt memory and potentially execute code.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分为9.8的BZFlag游戏服务器缺陷存在堆越界写入漏洞，允许未认证的远程攻击者篡改内存并可能执行恶意代码。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 Rapid7 Metasploit Framework initialization flaw misconfigures PostgreSQL with trust authentication and world-accessible Unix domain sockets.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分为7.8的Rapid7 Metasploit Framework初始化缺陷会导致PostgreSQL被错误配置为使用信任认证及全局可访问的Unix域套接字。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 libp2p cryptographic library flaw accepts crafted public keys before peer-ID verification, risking ASN.1 DER decoding attacks and protocol manipulation.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分为7.5的libp2p加密库缺陷在对等节点ID验证前接受伪造的公钥，存在引发ASN.1 DER解码攻击和协议篡改的风险。
